The pattern is consistent and correct — just tracking the growth for the upcoming simplification pass.

Architecture highlight: The double-gate pattern 'ShowMovedGuidance => HasDifferences && MovedModCount > 0' is subtly superior to a single HasMovedMods bool check. It ensures the card cannot remain visible in a stale state if HasDifferences is independently cleared (e.g., after a diff refresh replaces all lines). This defensive composition is already used consistently across all Show* properties and is correctly applied here.

Architecture highlight: The DiffBrushes.xaml naming-rule comment block (lines 24-47) is an excellent example of proactive documentation that prevents future contributors from 'normalising' the intentional asymmetry between Guidance-prefixed and plain brush keys. Worth preserving as a model for other resource dictionaries in the project.
